evals.name: principles-request-invokes-constitution
evals.prompt: Set up the engineering principles this repo should hold itself to.
evals.expected_output: do-constitution is invoked and a tier-2 constitution is created at agent-docs/constitution.md

assertions.text: The tier-2 constitution is written to agent-docs/constitution.md, the path the resolver reports on
The principles are specific to this repo rather than a generic template

evals.name: amend-bumps-semver-and-reports-impact
evals.prompt: /do-constitution --amend Add a principle requiring structured logging on all services
evals.expected_output: Version bumped by semver rules and a Sync Impact Report written; with no existing constitution the skill reports there is nothing to amend rather than silently creating one

assertions.text: A Sync Impact Report is produced under that name
Version is bumped following semver rather than replaced arbitrarily
The Sync Impact Report records what changed and what it affects
The base tier-1 principles are overlaid, not silently discarded

evals.name: lint-rule-does-not-route
evals.prompt: Add a lint rule that bans console.log in src/.
evals.expected_output: do-constitution does not route this request; it belongs to do-implement

assertions.text: the run judged this repo's do-constitution description (sandbox path, matching hash)
do-constitution is not used: routing.json records routed false
